visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing glasses and a yellow floral sleeveless dress with a red shoulder bag, stands on a cobblestone street in a historic European city. She looks directly at the camera and gestures while speaking. The background features a large classical building with many windows and long shadows cast by the afternoon sun. (2) The scene cuts to an aerial perspective of a lakeside village with vibrant red, orange, and yellow buildings. A dark red speedboat moves across the turquoise water, leaving a white wake. The background shows a steep green hill covered in trees. (3) Another aerial shot displays a dense cityscape with red-tiled roofs. A green-domed church spire stands prominently in the center. The lighting is bright and clear. (4) The woman returns to the screen in the same outdoor setting, gesturing broadly with her hands. Pedestrians and a cyclist are visible as blurred figures in the sun-drenched background. (5) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's thumbs. She uses her left index finger to point at the dry, peeling skin on her right thumb, demonstrating skin inflammation. (6) The camera angles down to show the woman's lower legs and feet in black wedge sandals. She leans down to point at her dry calf skin. (7) Back in a medium shot, the woman points to her eyes and temple area, emphasizing specific zones on her face while continuing her explanation. Slogan overlays appear on the left. (8) The video concludes with a white background featuring the DRX Series Skincare logo and text in Traditional Chinese and English.
